spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of sparse grass against a plain light background. It is a stout quadruped with an elongated pointed snout, a large dark eye, and a small rounded ear, its body covered mostly in overlapping tan to brown scales except for a thick, shaggy, dark brown fur mantle that covers the entire dorsal side from the back of the neck over the back and rump. It stands on four sturdy columnar legs with scaly outer surfaces and broad feet ending in dark blunt hoof-like nails, and has a long, thick-based, tapering tail covered in scales extending horizontally behind it to the right.

meta_spark.description: A quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on four short sturdy legs with a long tapering tail extending behind. It has an elongated narrow head with a pointed snout and a large dark eye. The top of the head, sides of the neck and body, outer legs, and tail are covered in overlapping brown keratin scales, while the entire arched back and top of the neck are covered in dense long shaggy dark brown fur. The feet end in short dark blunt claws.
